about: ROUNDS's loop on Cuphead's campaign: a level is a match. Every game over gives each player a pick on the game-over card (the loser picks), the deck is kept through retries and trips to the map, and winning the level wipes it. Nothing is permanent; Porkrind's pack is a head start on the next attempt. Every pick shows offerSize real ROUNDS cards chosen with ROUNDS's own rarity weights and duplicate/blacklist rules. Decks are saved per Cuphead save slot and per player in %LOCALAPPDATA%/CupRounds/saves; tuning deckCap (0 = none) bounds a deck.

columns.symbol: method in src/CupheadMod that applies it

rows.when: a game over on a level ROUNDS's players are in (every player dead, or a Mausoleum urn lost): each player picks on the game-over card, before Retry or Exit to Map
a level ROUNDS's players are in is won (boss, run-and-gun, mausoleum, King Dice himself): both decks are wiped; a Dice Palace mini boss keeps them, plane levels and the tutorial take no part
buying a card pack at Porkrind's Emporium: one card into the current deck, a head start on the next attempt (wiped at the win like the rest)
